units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 8:3:2">Y. Snh. VIII, 26ᵇ</cite> top <he>לא תִגְנוֹב את … גוֹנֵב</he> do not carry off steathily thine own property from the thief, lest thou appear to be stealing.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 86a:15">Snh. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>גונב נפש</he> one who kidnaps a person.
B. Kam. VII, 2 ג׳ על פי שנים if he is convicted of stealing through two witnesses; a. fr.—ג׳ דעת to deceive, to create a false impression.

<cite ref="Chullin 94a:5">Ḥull. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>אסור לִגְנוֹב דעת וכ׳</he> it is forbidden to create &c. (e.g. to make believe as if you opened a fresh barrel of wine as a special attention to your guest, while you would have had to do it at any rate).
Shebu. 39ᵃ; a. fr.—ג׳ עין to deceive by a false impression on the eye, to delude.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 4:12">B. Mets. IV, 12</cite>.—Part. pass. <he>גָּנוּב</he>, f. <cite ref="C01100"><he>גְּנוּבָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 44b">Ab. Zar. 44ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Meilah 7b:4">Meïl. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>תשובה ג׳</he> a fallacious reply; v. <cite ref="C01102"><he>גְּנוּבְתָּא</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 5">Ex. R. s. 5</cite> <he>היו מְגַנְּבִין את עצמן וכ׳</he> they kept themselves at a distance from Moses and then withdrew.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84:16">Gen. R. s. 84</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 7:8">Tosef. B. Kam. VII, 8</cite> sq.; Mekh. Mishp. N’zikin, s. 13.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 21:1">Pesik. R. s. 21</cite>, <he>היו מִתְגַּנְּבִים וכ׳</he> they used to have stealthy intercourse &c. Mekh. l. c. <he>המִתְגַּנֵּב אחר וכ׳</he> who steals himself (into the college room) behind a neighbor.
